newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU wheat/rye/barley correctives all zero.
newsitem.headline: EU wheat/rye/barley correctives all zero.

text.p: The European Union has introduced a monthly corrective of zero Ecus for exports of soft wheat, rye and barley, industry sources said on Thursday.
The decision is a technical move linked to the launch later Thursday of 1997/98 export tenders for these three types of grain.
The correctives -- monthly differentials applied to grain export licences -- had previously been pegged at "nil value".
The new corrective of zero applies to all five periods for which grain export licences are valid, the sources said.
Grain export licences are issued for the current month plus a further four months. A licence issued Thursday would therefore be valid until the end of November.
